measure: หนังสือเวียน ที่ ฝนส. (23) ว. 86/2554 เรื่อง ขอความร่วมมือในการให้ความช่วยเหลือลูกหนี้ที่ได้รับผลกระทบจากอุทกภัย (Request for cooperation in assisting flood-affected debtors)
eligibility_thresholds: Asked institutions to relax repayment terms and restructure the debts of flood-affected debtors. Known only from its citation and repeal in circular ว. 1564/2554 (p. 1-2); its own text was not opened.

measure: หนังสือเวียน ที่ ธปท. ฝนส. (23) ว. 1564/2554 เรื่อง การซักซ้อมความเข้าใจมาตรการการให้ความช่วยเหลือลูกหนี้ที่ได้รับผลกระทบจากอุทกภัย (Clarification of measures to assist flood-affected debtors): classification and restructuring
issuer: BOT (Deputy Governor, Financial Institution Stability, for the Governor)
eligibility_thresholds: Debtors classified Normal or Special Mention hit by force majeure 'such as the floods since July 2011' (ภาวะอุทกภัยตั้งแต่เดือนกรกฎาคม 2554). The institution may keep the pre-disaster classification; the relief counts as general debt restructuring (GDR), not troubled debt restructuring (TDR). It covers debtors in emergency disaster areas declared in Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM, Ministry of Interior) publications and debtors outside them who were indirectly affected. Conditions: a clear assistance policy; the institution must prove or link the flood impact on each debtor; monthly reporting of assisted balances (Table 1 from end-Oct 2011, Table 2 by debtor, province and business type from end-Sep 2011, both to end-Jun 2012).
affected_groups: All financial institutions, non-bank credit-card issuers and non-bank supervised personal-loan operators; business (corporate and SME) and retail debtors

measure: ว. 1564/2554 section 2(2): ปรับลดอัตราการผ่อนชำระหนี้บัตรเครดิตขั้นต่ำ (credit-card minimum-payment relief)
eligibility_thresholds: Issuers may cut the credit-card minimum payment below 10% of the outstanding balance for directly or indirectly flood-affected cardholders, at their discretion, until 30 Jun 2012. Q&A item 2 (first Q&A sheet): the size of the cut is left to the issuer.
affected_groups: Credit-card holders; banks and non-bank issuers

measure: คำถาม-คำตอบแนบท้ายหนังสือเวียน ว. 1564/2554 (Q&A): eligibility date, income recognition, upgrading, losses
eligibility_thresholds: Q1: BOT sets no cut-off date for the classification freeze; institutions 'may use 25 July 2011, per Ministry of Interior publications' as a first guide. Q2: accrual-basis interest income may continue for assisted Normal/SM debtors. Q3: upgrading from Special Mention to Normal still needs at least 3 consecutive months or instalments of performance. Q4: assisted debtors are not reported as GDR or TDR in the restructuring data sets (so not flagged as restructured). Q6: terms may be revised until 31 Dec 2012 without losing the frozen classification, provided this does not evade classification and provisioning. Q7: losses from restructuring must be recognised and provisioned.

effective_date: Revaluations due by 2012-06-30; old value usable up to 1 year after the due date, no later than 2012-12-31
measure: ว. 1564/2554 Q&A item 8: ผ่อนผันการประเมินราคาหลักประกันและอสังหาริมทรัพย์รอการขาย (deferral of collateral and foreclosed-property revaluation)
eligibility_thresholds: Applies generally in all areas (not only flooded ones) to real-estate collateral, marketable machinery and foreclosed real estate (NPA) whose revaluation fell due by 30 Jun 2012. The previous appraisal may be used for up to one year beyond the due date, capped at 31 Dec 2012 (example: due 15 Nov 2011, usable to 14 Nov 2012; due 31 Mar 2012, usable to 31 Dec 2012). Institutions must plan staggered revaluation within the window.
affected_groups: Financial institutions' collateral and NPA books

measure: BOT restructuring rule: restructured flood debtors leave the NPL list after one payment instead of three (as reported by the World Bank)
eligibility_thresholds: Viable flood-hit borrowers at all banks. Not found in ว. 1564/2554, whose Q&A item 3 keeps the 3-month rule for upgrading Special Mention loans; it may sit in another circular.

measure: Postponement of a planned cut in the maximum mortgage LTV
eligibility_thresholds: Not stated

measure: Three-year moratorium on principal and interest at specialised financial institutions (SFIs) and cooperatives
issuer: Cabinet; SFIs (BAAC, GSB, GHB, SME Bank, Islamic Bank, SMC)
eligibility_thresholds: Flood-hit borrowers with total debt under THB 500,000; same for cooperative farm loans.

measure: TCG credit guarantees and GSB soft loans for SMEs
issuer: Cabinet; Thai Credit Guarantee Corporation; Government Savings Bank
eligibility_thresholds: TCG guarantees up to THB 100 bn of new SME loans (rate capped at 3% for 3 years); GSB lends THB 20 bn to banks at 0.01%, matched 50:50, 3% cap to borrowers.

measure: พระราชกำหนดการให้ความช่วยเหลือทางการเงินแก่ผู้ที่ได้รับความเสียหายจากอุทกภัย พ.ศ. 2555 (Emergency Decree on Financial Assistance to Persons Damaged by Floods, B.E. 2555)
issuer: Royal Thai Government; facility operated by BOT
eligibility_thresholds: Facility capped at THB 300 bn. BOT lends to institutions at 0.01% a year for at most 70% of each loan. On-lending to individuals and businesses in flood-affected areas capped at 3% a year. Apply by 31 Dec 2013; repay within 5 years, by 31 Dec 2018 at the latest.
affected_groups: Flood-zone individuals and SMEs via financial institutions

measure: พระราชกำหนดกองทุนส่งเสริมการประกันภัยพิบัติ พ.ศ. 2555 (Emergency Decree on the Disaster Insurance Promotion Fund, B.E. 2555)
eligibility_thresholds: Fund of THB 50 bn (loan-financed). Cover capped at THB 100,000 for homes; SMEs and industry up to 30% of asset value. Premiums 0.50% (homes), 1.00% (SMEs), 1.25% (industry). Royal Gazette entry not opened; terms from a BOT article.
affected_groups: Households, SMEs, industry buying disaster cover

announcement_date: 2018-10-31 (Royal Gazette vol. 135, special part 314 ง, 2018-12-11; sent to banks by circular ฝนส.(01)ว.195/2561 of 2018-12-13)
effective_date: Financial statements beginning on or after 2020-01-01
measure: ประกาศธนาคารแห่งประเทศไทย ที่ สนส. 23/2561 เรื่อง หลักเกณฑ์การจัดชั้นและการกันเงินสำรองของสถาบันการเงิน (Asset classification and provisioning; TFRS 9 alignment), issued with สนส. 20-22/2561 and แนวนโยบาย เรื่อง การปรับปรุงโครงสร้างหนี้ (debt-restructuring policy)
eligibility_thresholds: Replaces สนส. 5/2559. Moves classification to TFRS 9 categories: performing, under-performing (significant increase in credit risk) and credit-impaired, i.e. stages 1-3. Still listed as the current classification rule in BOT's index of notifications (downloaded 2026-11-02). Detailed ECL and collateral clauses were not read: the notification PDF is scanned.
affected_groups: Commercial banks, finance companies, credit foncier companies

measure: มาตรฐานการรายงานทางการเงิน ฉบับที่ 9 เรื่อง เครื่องมือทางการเงิน (TFRS 9 Financial Instruments) and related standards: effective date for banks
issuer: Federation of Accounting Professions (สภาวิชาชีพบัญชี)
eligibility_thresholds: Effective for financial statements beginning on or after 1 Jan 2020 (stated in BOT circular ว.195/2561, p. 1). SFIs follow a separate BOT track (not verified).

measure: แนวนโยบาย เรื่อง การประเมินราคาหลักประกันและอสังหาริมทรัพย์รอการขายที่ได้มาจากการรับชำระหนี้ การประกันการให้สินเชื่อ หรือที่ซื้อจากการขายทอดตลาดของสถาบันการเงิน (Policy on appraisal of collateral and foreclosed real estate)
eligibility_thresholds: Purpose clause: governs collateral values that institutions use in provisioning under the classification and provisioning rules. Revaluation frequency (s. 4.2.5): performing and under-performing (stage 1-2) collateral at the institution's discretion, consistent with its risk policy; AVMs, price databases and statistical models are allowed with validation, back-testing and at least annual policy review (Annex 3). Credit-impaired (stage 3) collateral: commercial and residential real estate, other real estate, marketable machinery and insured vehicles revalued every 3 years (Annex 4), with annual depreciation for machinery and vehicles. Methods follow SEC-endorsed valuation standards (cost, sales-comparison and income approaches). Foreclosed real estate is revalued every year, and impairment must be considered whenever a value decline is indicated. Whether external or internal appraisers are used depends on BOT's risk rating of the institution's largest business-lending segment. Repeals the policy of 10 Jun 2016. A full-text search for กรมธนารักษ์ found no reference to Treasury Department appraisal values.
affected_groups: Financial institutions under the Financial Institutions Businesses Act (SFIs have a separate policy, not opened)

measure: ประกาศธนาคารแห่งประเทศไทย ที่ สนส. 1/2563 เรื่อง หลักเกณฑ์การกำกับดูแลสินเชื่อเพื่อที่อยู่อาศัยและสินเชื่ออื่นที่เกี่ยวเนื่องกับสินเชื่อเพื่อที่อยู่อาศัย (Housing-loan LTV rules)
eligibility_thresholds: Current LTV framework for housing loans; existence and date verified only through its citation in circular ว.8158/2568 (2025). Thresholds not read.

announcement_date: 2022 (PDF created 2022-09-29 per file metadata; no printed date found)
measure: ทิศทางการพัฒนาสู่ความยั่งยืนด้านสิ่งแวดล้อม ภายใต้ภูมิทัศน์ใหม่ภาคการเงินไทย (Directional paper: Transitioning towards environmental sustainability)
eligibility_thresholds: Plans (not commitments to dates later verified): Standard Practice in Q3 2022; industry handbook in H1/Q2 2023; climate scenario analysis and a stress-test pilot with large commercial banks by end-2023, extended to all Thai banks in 2024, starting with high-impact scenarios and later feeding Pillar 2 capital assessment; Thailand Taxonomy starting with energy and transport, then agriculture and industry from late 2023.

announcement_date: Round announced late 2022 (central Treasury notice not opened)
measure: บัญชีราคาประเมินทุนทรัพย์ที่ดิน รอบบัญชี พ.ศ. 2566-2569 (Official land appraisal schedule, round 2023-2026)
issuer: Treasury Department (กรมธนารักษ์)
eligibility_thresholds: Parcel-level official appraisal used for land-registration fees and taxes; published as open CSV (dataset created_date 2023-01-01). Provincial Treasury pages list amendments during the round (e.g. 7 May and 21 Aug 2024, Buriram, search listing only). Round dates rest on press reports and dataset metadata.

measure: แนวนโยบายธนาคารแห่งประเทศไทย เรื่อง การดำเนินธุรกิจสถาบันการเงินโดยคำนึงถึงมิติด้านสิ่งแวดล้อมและการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศ (Standard Practice: internalising environmental and climate-change aspects into financial institutions' business)
eligibility_thresholds: Flood named as an acute physical risk (fn. 3). Scenario analysis and stress testing appear only as an example ('เช่น') of forward-looking risk assessment (item 2.3), with no prescribed scenario, horizon or frequency. Incorporating environmental risk into collateral valuation is given as an example control for high-risk customers (item 3.2). Disclosure refers to TCFD and ISSB.

measure: Thailand Taxonomy ระยะที่ 1: มาตรฐานการจัดกลุ่มกิจกรรมทางเศรษฐกิจที่คำนึงถึงสิ่งแวดล้อมของประเทศไทย (Thailand Taxonomy Phase 1)
issuer: BOT with the Thailand Taxonomy Board (other members not verified)
eligibility_thresholds: Date from BOT green-finance page. Sectors covered not stated on that page (the 2022 directional paper planned energy and transport first).

measure: คู่มือการดำเนินธุรกิจสถาบันการเงิน คำนึงถึงสิ่งแวดล้อมและการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศ (Industry Handbook on internalising environmental and climate-change aspects)
eligibility_thresholds: Implementation guidance for the Standard Practice; published later than the H1 2023 target in the Standard Practice Q&A.

measure: โครงการนำร่องการทดสอบภาวะวิกฤตในมิติการเปลี่ยนแปลงสภาพภูมิอากาศ (climate stress test) (Pilot climate stress test)
eligibility_thresholds: Pilot with D-SIBs and other commercial banks that are ready, 'starting with physical risk' (เริ่มจากความเสี่ยงทางกายภาพ). No scenario, hazard, start/end date or results are published on the page.

effective_date: From the date an area is declared a disaster zone, for up to 12 months
measure: ธปท. ผ่อนปรนหลักเกณฑ์และขอความร่วมมือให้สถาบันการเงินและ non-bank ให้ความช่วยเหลือลูกหนี้ที่ได้รับผลกระทบจากสาธารณภัย (Standing disaster-relief template)
eligibility_thresholds: Debtors in areas declared disaster zones (เขตพื้นที่ประสบสาธารณภัย) or at disaster-situation level yellow, orange or red. Measures approved within 12 months of the declaration: credit-card minimum payment below the BOT floor; emergency personal-loan limits above the BOT cap; for all loan types, rate or fee cuts, payment relief or restructuring. Debtors may keep their pre-disaster classification. First applied to the 2024 northern and upper-central floods.
affected_groups: Banks, SFIs, non-bank credit-card and personal-loan operators; retail and business debtors

measure: Thailand Taxonomy ระยะที่ 2 (Thailand Taxonomy Phase 2, 'Thailand Taxonomy 2.0')
issuer: BOT with the Thailand Taxonomy Board (other members not verified)
eligibility_thresholds: Full version announced at a joint press briefing; sectors not stated on the BOT page.

measure: BOT-World Bank flood scenario (2011-based, climate-adjusted, Bangkok and nearby provinces)
eligibility_thresholds: Scenario: output loss of up to 10%; 41% of bank corporate lending in districts with high riverine flood risk and 7% in very-high-risk districts. BOT asked banks to use the World Bank scenarios to assess their climate-risk systems (as described by the World Bank; no BOT document found).

effective_date: From the Cabinet resolution of 2025-12-02; opt-in by 2026-01-31; relief up to 12 months
measure: ขอความร่วมมือให้ความช่วยเหลือลูกหนี้ที่ได้รับผลกระทบจากสาธารณภัยในเขตพื้นที่เกิดสาธารณภัยร้ายแรงอย่างยิ่ง (ระดับ 4) (Relief for debtors in Level-4 'extremely severe' disaster zones; 2025 southern floods)
eligibility_thresholds: Retail and SME debtors in Level-4 disaster zones that were not NPL on the Cabinet resolution date: principal moratorium and interest waiver for up to 12 months from opt-in, opt-in by 31 Jan 2026. Relaxations: home-repair loans secured on the dwelling and approved within 12 months are excluded from the LTV calculation under สนส. 1/2563 and risk-weighted at 35% (SA/SSA banks); personal-loan limits ignore the three-lender cap; card debt can convert to term loans; the NPA holding period under สนส. 5/2565 is not counted for 12 months, with no extra holding provisions. SFIs follow the Cabinet-specified measures and areas.
affected_groups: Banks, their group subsidiaries, SFIs, non-bank lenders; retail and SME debtors in Level-4 zones

measure: บัญชีราคาประเมินทุนทรัพย์ที่ดิน รอบบัญชี พ.ศ. 2570-2573 (Official land appraisal schedule, round 2027-2030)
issuer: Treasury Department (กรมธนารักษ์)
eligibility_thresholds: Not yet published as of 2026-11-02. Press report: increases along Bangkok rail lines expected to be capped at 10-20%.
